svg.text: OBJ-201 Planter, plant stand, disc base and two plates
Approved by Sabry 25 Nov 2026. Production review pending. Not engineered
معتمد من سبري ٢٥ نوفمبر ٢٠٢٦، بانتظار مراجعة التصنيع، غير مهندس
Dashed circles: pot stand-in rim Ø200 and base Ø155 (not ours). Shelf flanges lie below the top disc.
Red dash-dot: cut planes D-D (y 0) and E-E (y 125), see sheet 5.
The stand rests on the two base flanges. Dashed: shelf flanges above. No feet, no levelling.
Footprint is the base flange pair; the centre strip between the plates is open to the floor.
